blocks.text: GENEVA, Switzerland — A Swiss and an Austrian woman kidnapped by suspected jihadists in Niger more than a year and a half ago were back in their home countries Thursday, after Libya reportedly intervened for their release. Eva Gretzmacher, 76, was pictured hugging her son in Vienna, while Claudia Abbt, 69, was seen on Swiss soil having flown back into Bern. The two had earlier arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi, Libyan television channel Al Masar there reported earlier.
